title: How to spend one trillion dollars: the US decarbonization conundrum
The End of Neutrality? LCFS, Technology Neutrality, and Stimulating the EV Market
Correcting Estimates of Electric Vehicle Emissions Abatement: Implications for Climate Policy
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists 10(1): 263-282
abstract: Transportation electrification is viewed by many as a cornerstone for climate change mitigation, with the ultimate vision to phase out conventional vehicles entirely. In a world with only electric vehicles (EVs), transportation pollution would be primarily determined by the composition of the electricity grid. For the foreseeable future, however, environmental benefits of EVs must be measured relative to the (likely gasoline) car that would have been bought instead. This so-called counterfactual vehicle cannot be observed, but its fuel economy can be estimated. A quasi-experiment in California allows us to show that subsidized buyers of EVs would have, on average, purchased relatively fuel-efficient cars had they not gone electric. The actual incremental pollution abatement arising from EVs today is thus substantially smaller than one would predict using the fleet average as the counterfactual vehicle. We discuss implications for climate policy and how to accurately reflect EV choice in integrated assessment models.
abstract_zh: 交通电气化被许多人视为气候变化减缓的基石，其最终愿景是彻底淘汰传统汽车。在一个只有电动汽车（EV）的世界里，交通污染将主要取决于电网的构成。然而，在可预见的未来，电动汽车的环境效益必须相对于人们本会购买的（很可能是汽油）汽车来衡量。这种所谓的反事实车辆无法被直接观察到，但其燃油经济性可以加以估计。加利福尼亚州的一项准实验使我们能够表明，若非购买电动汽车，获得补贴的购车者平均而言会购买燃油效率相对较高的汽车。因此，当前电动汽车实际带来的增量减排量，远小于若以车队平均水平作为反事实车辆所预测的减排量。我们讨论了这一结论对气候政策的启示，以及如何在综合评估模型中准确反映电动汽车的选择行为。

title: Global Transportation Decarbonization
abstract: A number of policy proposals call for replacing fossil fuels in the name of decarbonization, but these fuels will be difficult to replace due to to their as-yet unrivaled bundle of attributes: abundance, ubiquity, energy density, transportability and cost. There is a growing commitment to electrification as the dominant decarbonization pathway for transportation. While deep electrification is promising for road vehicles in wealthy countries, it will face steep obstacles. In other sectors and in the developing world, it’s not even in pole position. Global transportation decarbonization will require decoupling emissions from economic growth, and decoupling emissions from growth will require not only new technologies, but cooperation in governance. The menu of policy options is replete with tradeoffs, particularly as the primacy of energy security and reliability (over emissions abatement) has once again been demonstrated in Europe and elsewhere.
abstract_zh: 许多政策建议主张以脱碳之名替代化石燃料，但由于化石燃料具备无可匹敌的综合特性——储量丰富、分布广泛、能量密度高、便于运输且成本低廉——它们将难以被替代。越来越多的人承诺以电气化作为交通领域脱碳的主要路径。尽管深度电气化在富裕国家的道路车辆上前景可观，但将面临严峻障碍。在其他部门以及发展中世界，电气化甚至尚未处于首选地位。全球交通脱碳需要使排放与经济增长脱钩，而要实现这种脱钩，不仅需要新技术，还需要治理上的合作。政策选项的菜单充满权衡取舍，尤其是在欧洲及其他地区，能源安全与可靠性（优先于减排）的首要地位再次得到了体现。

title: The Economics of Electric Vehicles
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy 17(2): 274-294
abstract: We examine the private and public economics of electric vehicles (EVs) and discuss when market forces will produce the optimal path of EV adoption. Privately, consumer cost savings from EVs vary. Some experience net benefits from choosing gasoline cars, even after accounting for EV subsidies. Publicly, we survey the literature documenting the external costs and benefits of EVs and highlight several themes for optimal policy design including, 1) promoting regional variation in EV policies that align private incentives with social benefits, 2) pursuing a time-path of policies that reflect changing marginal benefits, and 3) rationalizing electricity and gasoline prices to reflect their social marginal cost. On the extensive margin, purchase incentives should ramp-down as learning-by-doing and network externalities (to the extent that they exist) diminish; on the intensive margin, gasoline should become relatively more expensive over time than electricity (per mile traveled) to reflect cleaner marginal emissions from electricity generation.
abstract_zh: 我们考察电动汽车（EV）的私人与公共经济学，并讨论市场力量何时能够产生最优的电动汽车普及路径。从私人角度看，电动汽车带来的消费者成本节约因人而异。即使计入电动汽车补贴，一些消费者选择燃油汽车仍能获得净收益。从公共角度看，我们梳理了记录电动汽车外部成本与收益的文献，并重点提出最优政策设计的几个要点：（1）推行区域差异化的电动汽车政策，使私人激励与社会效益相一致；（2）实施随边际收益变化而调整的时间路径政策；（3）调整电价和油价，使其反映社会边际成本。在扩展边际（即是否购买）上，随着边做边学效应和网络外部性（若确实存在）的减弱，购置补贴应逐步退坡；在集约边际（即使用强度）上，随着时间推移，每英里行驶的油价相对于电价应逐步提高，以反映电力发电更为清洁的边际排放。

title: Future paths of electric vehicle adoption in the United States: Predictable determinants, obstacles and opportunities
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy 3(1): 71-110
abstract: This paper identifies and quantifies major determinants of future electric vehicle demand to inform widely held aspirations for market growth. Our model compares three channels that will affect electric vehicle market share in the United States from 2020 to 2035: intrinsic (no-subsidy) electric vehicle demand growth, net-of-subsidy electric vehicle cost declines (e.g., batteries), and government subsidies. Geographic variation in preferences for sedans and light trucks highlights the importance of viable electric vehicle alternatives to conventional light trucks; belief in climate change is highly correlated with electric vehicle adoption patterns; and the first $500 billion in cumulative nationwide electric vehicle subsidies is associated a 7%–10% increase in electric vehicle market share in 2035, an effect that diminishes as subsidies increase. The rate of intrinsic demand growth dwarfs the impact of demand-side subsidies and battery cost declines, highlighting the importance of nonmonetary factors (e.g., charging infrastructure, product quality, and/or cultural acceptance) on electric vehicle demand.
abstract_zh: 本文识别并量化了未来电动汽车需求的主要决定因素，以评估人们广泛寄予的市场增长期望。我们的模型比较了三个将影响2020年至2035年美国电动汽车市场份额的渠道：内在的（无补贴）电动汽车需求增长、扣除补贴后的电动汽车成本下降（例如电池成本），以及政府补贴。轿车与轻型卡车偏好的地域差异凸显了可行的电动汽车替代品对于替代传统轻型卡车的重要性；对气候变化的信念与电动汽车的采用模式高度相关；而累计达5000亿美元的首批全国性电动汽车补贴，与2035年电动汽车市场份额提高7%至10%相关联，且该效应随补贴增加而递减。内在需求增长的速度远远超过需求侧补贴和电池成本下降的影响，这凸显了非货币因素（例如充电基础设施、产品质量和/或文化接受度）对电动汽车需求的重要性。

title: Pass-Through of Own and Rival Cost Shocks: Evidence from the U.S. Fracking Boom
abstract: In imperfectly competitive settings, a firm's price depends on its own costs as well as those of its competitors. We demonstrate that this has important implications for the estimation and interpretation of pass-through. Leveraging a large input cost shock resulting from the fracking boom, we isolate price responses to firm-specific, regional, and industry-wide input cost shocks in the U.S. oil refining industry. The pass-through of these components varies from near zero to full pass-through, reconciling seemingly disparate results from the literature. We illustrate the policy implications of rival cost pass-through in the context of a tax on refinery carbon emissions.
abstract_zh: 在不完全竞争的环境中，企业的价格既取决于其自身成本，也取决于竞争对手的成本。我们证明，这对传递率（pass-through）的估计与解释具有重要影响。利用页岩油气开采热潮带来的大规模投入成本冲击，我们在美国炼油行业中分离出对企业特定、区域性和行业范围投入成本冲击的价格反应。这些成分的传递率从接近零到完全传递不等，从而调和了文献中看似相互矛盾的结果。我们在对炼油厂碳排放征税的情境中，阐明了竞争对手成本传递的政策含义。

title: Subsidizing Low- and Middle-income Adoption of Electric Vehicles: Quasi-Experimental Evidence from California
abstract: Little is known about electric vehicle (EV) demand by low-and middle-income households. In this paper, we exploit a policy that provides exogenous variation in large EV subsidies targeted at the mass market in California. Using transaction-level data, we estimate three important policy parameters: the rate of subsidy pass-through, the impact of the subsidy on EV adoption, and the elasticity of demand for EVs among low-and middle-income households. Demand for EVs in our sample is price-elastic (-3.3) and pass-through to buyers is indistinguishable from 100 percent. We use these estimates to calculate that the expected subsidy bill required for California to reach its goal of 1.5 million EVs by 2025 is likely to exceed $12-18 billion.
abstract_zh: 关于中低收入家庭的电动汽车（EV）需求，我们所知甚少。本文利用加利福尼亚州一项面向大众市场、提供大额电动汽车补贴的政策所带来的外生变异，使用交易层面数据，估计了三个重要的政策参数：补贴传递率、补贴对电动汽车采用的影响，以及中低收入家庭对电动汽车需求的弹性。在我们的样本中，电动汽车需求具有价格弹性（-3.3），且补贴向购买者的传递率与100%没有显著差异。利用这些估计值，我们测算出加利福尼亚州若要实现2025年达到150万辆电动汽车的目标，所需的补贴支出很可能超过120亿至180亿美元。

title: Air Pollution and Criminal Activity: Microgeographic Evidence from Chicago
abstract: A growing literature documents that air pollution adversely impacts health, productivity, and cognition. This paper provides the first evidence of a causal link between air pollution and aggressive behavior, as documented by violent crime. Using the geolocation of crimes in Chicago from 2001–2012, we compare crime upwind and downwind of major highways on days when wind blows orthogonally to the road. Consistent with research linking pollution to aggression, we find that air pollution increases violent crime on the downwind sides of interstates. Our results suggest that pollution may reduce welfare and affect behavior through a wider set of channels than previously considered. (JEL K42, Q53)
abstract_zh: 越来越多的文献记载，空气污染会对健康、生产力和认知能力产生不利影响。本文首次提供了空气污染与攻击性行为之间因果联系的证据，以暴力犯罪为衡量指标。利用2001年至2012年芝加哥犯罪事件的地理位置数据，我们比较了在风向与道路正交的日子里，主要高速公路上风向与下风向的犯罪情况。与将污染与攻击性联系起来的研究相一致，我们发现，空气污染会增加州际公路下风向一侧的暴力犯罪。我们的结果表明，污染可能通过比以往所考虑的更广泛的渠道降低福利并影响行为。（JEL K42, Q53）

title: Who Bears the Economic Costs of Environmental Regulations?
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy 13(1): 62-82
abstract: Public economics has a well-developed literature on tax incidence – the ultimate burdens from tax policy. This literature is used here to describe not only the distributional effects of environmental taxes or subsidies but also the likely incidence of non-tax regulations, energy efficiency standards, or other environmental mandates. Recent papers find that mandates can be more regressive than carbon taxes. We also describe how the distributional effects of such policies can be altered by various market conditions such as limited factor mobility, trade exposure, evasion, corruption, or imperfect competition. Finally, we review data on carbon-intensity of production and exports around the world in order to describe implications for effects of possible carbon taxation on countries with different levels of income per capita.
abstract_zh: 公共经济学已形成关于税收归宿（即税收政策的最终负担）的成熟文献。本文借鉴这一文献，不仅用以描述环境税或补贴的分配效应，也用以描述节能标准或其他环境强制性规定等非税收监管措施可能的归宿。近期的研究发现，强制性规定可能比碳税更具累退性。我们还描述了，在有限要素流动性、贸易暴露、逃税、腐败或不完全竞争等各种市场条件下，此类政策的分配效应可能如何改变。最后，我们回顾了全球各国生产与出口的碳排放强度数据，以阐明在不同人均收入水平的国家中，可能的碳税征收将产生的影响。

title: Air Pollution as a Cause of Violent Crime
Tax Compliance and Fiscal Externalities: Evidence from U.S. Diesel Taxation
Does Tax-Collection Invariance Hold? Evasion and the Pass-Through of State Diesel Taxes
Consumer Learning and Hybrid Vehicle Adoption
abstract: We study the effect of differences in product quality on new technology diffusion. We propose a model in which heterogeneity in perceived product quality affects consumer adoption. If consumers experientially infer the quality of a technology, an increase in initial exposure to a low-quality product may inhibit subsequent diffusion. Incentives intended to speed up adoption may in fact have the opposite effect, if they propagate low-quality signals. We examine the predictions of the model using sales data for 11 hybrid-vehicle models between 2000 and 2006. Consistent with press reports that the first-generation Insight was perceived to be of lower quality than the first-generation Prius, we find that, conditional on overall hybrid vehicle adoption in the first two years, locations with a relatively high Prius market share experienced faster subsequent adoption than states with a relatively high Insight market share. We estimate the elasticity of new hybrid sales with respect to the Prius penetration rate is 0.30 to 0.55, while the elasticity with respect to the Insight penetration rate is –0.14 to –0.44.
abstract_zh: 我们研究产品质量差异对新技术扩散的影响。我们提出一个模型，其中感知产品质量的异质性会影响消费者的采用行为。如果消费者通过体验来推断技术的质量，那么在最初接触低质量产品的程度增加时，可能会抑制之后的扩散。若激励措施传播了低质量信号，旨在加快采用速度的激励措施实际上可能产生相反的效果。我们利用2000年至2006年间11款混合动力汽车车型的销售数据检验了模型的预测。与媒体报道一致（即第一代Insight被认为质量低于第一代Prius），我们发现，在前两年整体混合动力汽车采用率相同的条件下，Prius市场份额相对较高的地区，其后续采用速度快于Insight市场份额相对较高的州。我们估计，新混合动力汽车销量相对于Prius渗透率的弹性为0.30至0.55，而相对于Insight渗透率的弹性为–0.14至–0.44。

title: Land Use Regulation and Commuting Patterns
Tracking Employment Shocks using Mobile Phone Data
venue: Journal of the Royal Society Interface 12(107)

title: Cell Phones and Motor Vehicle Fatalities
abstract: The research objective of this project was to explore how the use of mobile devices affects driver safety. With almost all American adults owning a cell phone and other mobile devices currently, cell phone use while driving is thought to be extremely common. There have been significant concerns raised about distracted driving; however, relatively little consensus has been reached on the impact of distracted driving on safety. The results of this research are the first direct evidence linking call patterns and accidents in a non-experimental setting. As expected, the observational data strongly confirm the link between traffic injuries and death and mobile phone use.
abstract_zh: 本项目的研究目的在于探讨移动设备的使用如何影响驾驶安全。目前，几乎所有美国成年人都拥有手机及其他移动设备，因此人们普遍认为驾车时使用手机极为常见。分心驾驶问题已引起广泛关注，然而，关于分心驾驶对安全的影响，学界尚未达成较多共识。本研究的结果首次在非实验环境中提供了将通话模式与事故直接联系起来的证据。正如预期，观测数据有力地证实了交通伤亡与移动电话使用之间的联系。

title: Consumer Response to Cigarette Excise Tax Changes
Gasoline Taxes and Consumer Behavior
abstract: Gasoline taxes can be employed to correct externalities from automobile use and to raise government revenue. Our understanding of the optimal gasoline tax and the efficacy of existing taxes is largely based on empirical analysis of consumer responses to gasoline price changes. In this paper, we examine directly how gasoline taxes affect gasoline consumption as distinct from tax-inclusive retail gasoline prices. We find robust evidence that consumers respond more strongly to gasoline tax changes under a variety of model specifications. We discuss two potential reasons for our main findings as well as their implications. (JEL D12, H21, H25, H31, L71, Q35)
abstract_zh: 汽油税既可用于矫正汽车使用所产生的外部性，也可用于增加政府收入。我们对最优汽油税以及现行税收效力的理解，很大程度上基于对消费者对汽油价格变动反应的实证分析。在本文中，我们直接考察汽油税如何影响汽油消费，并将其与含税零售汽油价格的影响区分开来。我们发现，在多种模型设定下，消费者对汽油税变动的反应都更为强烈，这一结论稳健。我们讨论了导致主要发现的两种可能原因，以及它们的含义。（JEL D12, H21, H25, H31, L71, Q35）

title: Weather, Salience of Climate Change and Congressional Voting
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management 68(3): 435-448
abstract: Climate change is a complex long-run phenomenon. The speed and severity with which it is occurring is difficult to observe, complicating the formation of beliefs for individuals. We use Google search intensity data as a proxy for the salience of climate change and examine how search patterns vary with unusual local weather. We find that searches for “climate change” and “global warming” increase with extreme temperatures and unusual lack of snow. Furthermore, we demonstrate that effects of abnormal weather extend beyond search behavior to observable action on environmental issues. We examine the voting records of members of the U.S. Congress from 2004 to 2011 and find that members are more likely to take a pro-environment stance on votes when their home state experiences unusual weather.
abstract_zh: 气候变化是一种复杂的长期现象。其发生的速度和严重程度难以被直接观察，这使个人信念的形成变得复杂。我们以谷歌搜索强度数据作为气候变化显著性的代理变量，考察搜索模式如何随当地异常天气而变化。我们发现，“气候变化”和“全球变暖”的搜索量会随着极端气温以及异常的少雪天气而增加。此外，我们证明，异常天气的影响不仅限于搜索行为，还会延伸至环境议题上可观察到的行动。我们考察了2004年至2011年美国国会议员的投票记录，发现当议员所在州经历异常天气时，他们在表决中更有可能采取支持环境保护的立场。

title: Heuristic Strategies, Firm Behavior and Industry Information
venue: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization 86(1): 10-23

title: Giving Green to Get Green: Incentives and Consumer Adoption of Hybrid Vehicle Technology
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management 61: 1-15
abstract: Federal, state and local governments use a variety of incentives to induce consumer adoption of hybrid-electric vehicles. We study the relative efficacy of state sales tax waivers, income tax credits and non-tax incentives and find that the type of tax incentive offered is as important as the value of the tax incentive. Conditional on value, we find that sales tax waivers are associated a seven-fold greater increase in hybrid sales than income tax credits. In addition, we estimate the extent to which consumer adoption of hybrid-electric vehicles (HEV) in the United States from 2000-2006 can be attributed to government incentives, changing gasoline prices, or consumer preferences for environmental quality or energy security. After controlling for model specific state and time trends, we find that rising gasoline prices are associated with higher hybrid sales, although the effect operates entirely through sales of the hybrid models with the highest fuel economy. In total, we find that tax incentives, rising gasoline prices and social preferences are associated with 6, 27 and 36 percent of high economy hybrid sales from 2000-2006.
abstract_zh: 联邦、州和地方政府采用多种激励措施，以促使消费者采用混合动力电动汽车。我们研究了州销售税豁免、所得税抵免以及非税收激励的相对效力，发现所提供的税收激励类型与其价值同样重要。在价值相同的条件下，我们发现，销售税豁免与混合动力汽车销量的增幅相关联，其增幅是所得税抵免的七倍。此外，我们估计了2000年至2006年间美国消费者采用混合动力电动汽车（HEV）的现象在多大程度上可归因于政府激励、汽油价格变动，或消费者对环境质量或能源安全的偏好。在控制了各车型特定的州和时间趋势之后，我们发现，汽油价格上涨与混合动力汽车销量增加相关，但这一效应完全通过燃油经济性最高的混合动力车型的销售实现。总体而言，我们发现，税收激励、汽油价格上涨以及社会偏好分别与2000年至2006年间高燃油经济性混合动力汽车销量的6%、27%和36%相关联。

title: Tax Incidence and Supply Conditions
Do Americans Consume Too Little Natural Gas? An Empirical Test of Marginal Cost Pricing
abstract: This article measures the extent to which prices exceed marginal costs in the U.S. natural gas distribution market during the period 1991–2007. We find large departures from marginal cost pricing in all 50 states, with residential and commercial customers facing average markups of over 40%. Based on conservative estimates of the price elasticity of demand, these distortions impose hundreds of millions of dollars of annual welfare loss. Moreover, current price schedules are an important preexisting distortion which should be taken into account when evaluating carbon taxes and other policies aimed at addressing external costs.
abstract_zh: 本文衡量了1991年至2007年间美国天然气配送市场中价格超过边际成本的程度。我们发现，在全部50个州中，价格都显著偏离边际成本定价，居民和商业用户面临的平均加价幅度超过40%。基于对价格弹性的保守估计，这些扭曲造成每年数亿美元的福利损失。此外，现行的价格表本身就是一项重要的既有扭曲，在评估碳税以及其他旨在应对外部成本的政策时应当予以考虑。

title: Edgeworth Cycles Revisited
Crossing the Line: The Effect of Cross-Border Cigarette Sales on State Excise Tax Revenues
venue: B.E. Journal of Economic Analysis and Policy (Contributions) 8(1)

title: Measuring Illegal Activity and the Effects of Regulatory Innovation: Tax Evasion and the Dyeing of Untaxed Diesel
Energy Prices and Electric Vehicle Adoption
abstract: This paper presents evidence that gasoline prices have a larger effect on demand for electric vehicles (EVs) than electricity prices in California. We match a spatially-disaggregated panel dataset of monthly EV registration records to detailed records of gasoline and electricity prices in California from 2014-2017, and use these to estimate the effect of energy prices on EV demand. Two distinct empirical approaches (panel fixed-effects and a utility-border discontinuity) yield remarkably similar results: a given change in gasoline prices has roughly four to six times the effect on EV demand as a similar percentage change in electricity prices. We explore the implications for optimal EV subsidies, which promote externality reduction benefits and correct for consumer misoptimization stemming from the undervaluation of future electricity costs.
abstract_zh: 本文提供证据表明，在加州，汽油价格对电动汽车（EV）需求的影响大于电价。我们将2014至2017年加州按月的电动汽车注册记录（空间细分的面板数据）与详细的汽油和电价记录相匹配，并据此估计能源价格对电动汽车需求的影响。两种不同的实证方法（面板固定效应和电力公司服务区边界断点设计）得出了极为相似的结果：汽油价格的给定变动对电动汽车需求的影响，约为同等百分比电价变动影响的四至六倍。我们探讨了这一结果对最优电动汽车补贴的含义，此类补贴既能促进外部性减少带来的收益，也能纠正因低估未来电费成本而导致的消费者决策偏误。

title: The Effects of Competition in the Retail Gasoline Industry
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (accepted)
abstract: We estimate the effect of competition on incumbent firm pricing by using high frequency price data and the precise geographic location for all gas stations in California. Using an event study design, we find that the entry of a new station is associated with a 2.5 cent decrease in prices at incumbent stores, which equates to a 7% reduction in estimated retail markups. The effects are immediate, persistent, and show no sign of deterrence or limit pricing behavior. In contrast, nearby exit results in precisely estimated null effects on prices with no evidence of predatory pricing in the lead up to the station departure. The results are consistent across all fuel blends and dissipate with station distance. Finally, we explore the asymmetric effects, showing that the difference cannot be attributed to difference in branding, proximity to highway, or data quality idiosyncrasies, although we find suggestive evidence that exit tends to happen in more competitive markets and amongst less heavily trafficked stations.
abstract_zh: 我们利用高频价格数据以及加利福尼亚州所有加油站的精确地理位置，估计了竞争对在位企业定价的影响。采用事件研究设计，我们发现，新加油站的进入与在位加油站价格下降2.5美分相关，相当于估计零售加价幅度下降了7%。这些效应是即时的、持久的，且没有显示出阻吓或限制定价行为的迹象。相比之下，附近加油站的退出对价格的影响在估计上精确为零，且在加油站退出前也没有掠夺性定价的证据。这些结果在所有燃油品种中均保持一致，并随加油站之间距离的增加而消散。最后，我们探讨了不对称效应，表明这种差异不能归因于品牌、与高速公路的距离或数据质量的特殊性，不过我们发现有一定迹象表明，退出往往发生在竞争更激烈的市场以及交通流量较小的加油站之中。

title: Ideology, Incidence and the Political Economy of Fuel Taxes: Evidence from California 2018 Proposition 6
abstract: In 2018, California voters rejected Proposition 6, a ballot initiative that sought to repeal state gasoline taxes and vehicle fees enacted as part of the 2017 Road Repair and Accountability Act. We study the relationship between support for the proposition, political ideology and the economic burdens imposed by the Act. For every hundred dollars of annual per-household imposed costs, we estimate that support for the proposition rose by 3 - 9 percentage points. Notably, we find that the relationship between voting and the economic burden of the policy is seven times stronger in the most conservative tracts relative to the most liberal tracts. Since conservative areas in California and elsewhere tend to bear a higher burden from transportation and energy taxes than liberal areas, heterogeneity in the response to economic burdens has important implications for the popular support for environmental taxes and the ongoing policy debate about how to finance future road infrastructure.
abstract_zh: 2018年，加利福尼亚州选民否决了第6号提案，该提案旨在废除2017年《道路修缮与问责法》所设立的州汽油税和车辆费用。我们研究了对该提案的支持程度、政治意识形态以及该法案所施加的经济负担之间的关系。每户每年承担的成本每增加一百美元，我们估计对该提案的支持率随之上升3至9个百分点。值得注意的是，我们发现，在最保守的普查区，投票与政策经济负担之间的关系比最自由的普查区强七倍。由于加利福尼亚州及其他地区的保守派地区，通常比自由派地区承担更高的交通和能源税负担，因此对经济负担反应的异质性，对环境税的民众支持以及关于如何为未来道路基础设施融资的持续政策辩论具有重要含义。
